title: MariaDB/MySQL protocol improvement
description:
* since MariaDB 10.2, permit to use statement id 0xffffffff to use last prepared statement id
* Don't only rely on '5.5.5-' mariadb prefix, since can be removed with server variable. MariaDB doesn't set CLIENT_MYSQL/CLIENT_LONG_PASSWORD capability
* add MariaDB 10.6 flag MARIADB_CLIENT_CACHE_METADATA, column count packet has an additional skip meta flag indicating if metadata follows.
* correct AUTH_SWITCH_PACKET decoding (0xfe header)
* correct packet with 0xfe length check (OK_Packet with state change can have length > 9 but always less than 0xffffff)
* packet with 0xfe header with length > 0xffffff are row packet. This was set as unexpected
* improve dissect COM_STMT_PREPARE packet
* identify and dissect binary row packet
* add mariadb extended metadata protocol exchanged
* permit dissecting pipelining PREPARE + EXECUTE/BULK_EXECUTE
* correct EOF server status offset
